counting_rule: Foundation outputs, aliases, schemas and supplied pass-through are not extra delivered matrix feature producers.
supplied_origin: Selected supplied metrics are independently admitted with exact actual unit/model/formula/source; supplied signed delta requires explicit abs projection for greeks.delta. Never relabel supplied metrics computed BSM.

coverage_profile: option-quote-count1 is a per-contract declared sampling-slot ratio; not chain coverage, update count, continuous-time coverage, or inferred availability.
